title: CSS features, one to a page
what it holds: 78 short pages, each on one part of CSS and HTML: text, lists, tables, floats, flexbox, grid, positioning, columns, images, SVG, forms, page rules. The engine's own print test pages.

title: Business documents
what it holds: 8 everyday documents: an invoice, a statement, a letter, a receipt, a shipping label, a certificate, a report and a product sheet.

title: wkhtmltopdf's own options
what it holds: 19 command lines that use wkhtmltopdf's own features: text and HTML headers and footers with page numbers, a cover and a table of contents, bookmarks, paper sizes and margins, zoom, print media, a page built by a script, a page whose script comes from a file, a 150-row statement over several pages.

title: Languages and scripts
what it holds: 10 documents in Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Hebrew, Hindi, Thai, Greek, Russian and accented Latin, some mixed on one line. Run with Noto CJK added to the reference system, for both programs.
